basic_information.official_title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE OFFICIAL EMBLEM FOR THE BANGSAMORO AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO
signed_by: Atty. Ali Pangalian M. Balindong, Speaker
Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation in the BARMM

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Adopts the Official Bangsamoro Seal — a circular emblem with a rope border, a golden crescent and seven-rayed star on green — used to authenticate the region's official acts. An Arabic version is equally official.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: A government needs a mark that authenticates its own documents. The act adopts one and fixes its meaning, declaring the region a political entity that recognises the justness and legitimacy of the Bangsamoro cause.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: The region has an official seal for authenticating official acts, with each element given a stated meaning — and an Arabic-language version that carries the same official status as the English one.
who_will_be_affected: Bangsamoro government offices, which use the seal to authenticate official acts
Anyone receiving or checking an official Bangsamoro document
Arabic-reading users, since the Arabic version is expressly official
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2019 — 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. The region has an official seal that authenticates its official acts, and the Arabic version of it is just as official as the English one.
in_practice: Circular, bordered by a rope, with a slightly red strip inside the rope
'BANGSAMORO AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO' across the top, flanked by stars; '2019' at the bottom
A golden crescent with a seven-rayed star to its right, set on green
Lettering in green on white; rope, crescent and star in golden yellow
An Arabic version is also official

for_specific_groups.Government offices: The seal is the mark used to authenticate official acts.
for_specific_groups.Anyone verifying a document: The act describes each element, so a seal can be checked against the law.
for_specific_groups.Arabic readers: The Arabic version is official in its own right, not a translation of lesser standing.

what_you_can_do: Check an official Bangsamoro document against the description in Section 3 if its authenticity matters to you
watch_out_for: Unlike the flag act passed a week earlier, this one gives no hex codes — only colour names — so exact reproduction is left to practice.
The act creates no offence for forging or misusing the seal, and names no office to control its use.

key_terms_explained.Seal / emblem: The mark a government puts on a document to show it is genuinely its own act.
key_terms_explained.Qur'an 3:103: The verse the rope is drawn from — 'Hold tight to the rope of Allah, together. And be not divided.'

what_this_means_for_you.status_note: Passed 29 August 2019, approved by the Chief Minister on 6 September 2019.

benefits.headline: An official mark of authenticity for the region's acts, with an equally official Arabic version.

direct_benefits.benefit: A described, checkable seal on official documents
direct_benefits.who_gets_it: Anyone dealing with Bangsamoro government documents

direct_benefits.benefit: An Arabic version of equal official standing

indirect_benefits: A symbol that names Non-Moro Indigenous Peoples and other peoples in the region alongside the Bangsamoro, through the rope
limitations: No offence for misuse or forgery.
No funding and no controlling office.

for_citizens: None. The act imposes no duty on the public.

what_is_prohibited: The act defines no prohibited acts — it does not legislate on forgery or unauthorised use of the seal.

penalties.for_citizens: None. The act creates no offence, fine or imprisonment.

where_to_complain.first_stop: The office that issued the document
where_to_complain.note: The act names no implementing body and creates no complaints procedure.

everyday_scenarios: A resident receives a certificate from a Bangsamoro office and wants to know it is genuine. Section 3 describes the seal element by element — rope border, red inner strip, golden crescent and seven-rayed star on green, '2019' at the foot.
An office prepares documents for Arabic-speaking counterparts. The Arabic version of the seal is official, so it can be used without a separate authorisation.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Adopts the official emblem, referred to as the Official Bangsamoro Seal, for the authentication of the region's official acts and other purposes.

Section 2 — Policy: the region establishes itself as a political entity that recognises the justness and legitimacy of the cause of the Bangsamoro people, and adopts a seal reflective of its peoples' struggles and aspirations.

Section 3 — Design: circular, with 'BANGSAMORO AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO' at the upper portion preceded and ended by stars, and the year of the region's creation, '2019', at the lower portion. The outermost part is bordered by a rope; at the centre sits a crescent with a seven-rayed star to its right. The rope, crescent and star are golden yellow; a slightly red strip runs inside the rope; the crescent and star are set on green; the lettering is green on white.

Section 3 — Symbolism: the rope is the unity of the Bangsamoro, Non-Moro Indigenous Peoples and other peoples of the region, inspired by Qur'an 3:103, 'Hold tight to the rope of Allah, together. And be not divided.' The red strip is the blood of the fallen mujahideen. The crescent is the principles that guided those who struggled for self-determination. The seven-rayed star stands for Maguindanao, Lanao del Sur with Marawi City, Basilan with Lamitan City, Sulu, Tawi-Tawi, the City of Cotabato, and the 63 barangays formerly part of North Cotabato.
Section 3 — An Arabic version of the Official Bangsamoro Seal is likewise considered official.
Section 4 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.

implementation_status.note: Read from the enacted text as signed. The signed copy carries a colour plate of the emblem, marked 'EMBLEM ENGLISH VERSION', as its final page.

citizen_questions.a: Authenticating the region's official acts — it is the mark that shows a document is genuinely an act of the Bangsamoro Government.
Unity between the Bangsamoro, Non-Moro Indigenous Peoples and the other peoples of the region. The act cites Qur'an 3:103: 'Hold tight to the rope of Allah, together. And be not divided.'
Yes. Section 3 says an Arabic version of the seal is likewise considered official.
It is the year the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao was created.
No. The act names the colours — golden yellow, green, white, slightly red — but unlike the flag act it gives no hex codes.
